newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-REPUBLIC TO GROW EURODOLLAR PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-REPUBLIC TO GROW EURODOLLAR PROFIT.

text.p: U.S. group Republic Industries Inc, unveiling plans to buy EuroDollar (Holdings) Plc, said on Monday it expected to boost the British-based car rental company's revenues and profits with trans-Atlantic tourist traffic.
Republic agreed to buy EuroDollar for about 95.1 million stg, or 190p per share, in a recommended cash offer marking its first major acquisition in Europe's car rental sector.

"Eurodollar is close to being the jewel in the crown as far as Europe is concerned. It's a tremendous opportunity for us in terms of our global expansion into the car rental industry," said Goeff Corbett, managing director of Republic's European car rental division.

Republic, which owns five U.S. car rental chains including Alamo Rent-A-Car and National Car Rental, has worldwide car rental revenues of about $2.8 billion, representing some 30 percent of the group's total.

Corbett said Republic planned to use co-marketing deals to increase the number of U.S. tourists renting cars with EuroDollar in Britain, where about 95 percent of the company's business comes from UK residents.
"That's where we see the upside opportunity -- in generating inbound volumes to boost EuroDollar's total revenues in the UK," Corbett told Reuters in an interview.

"Because (North American customers) are already doing business with our existing brands in the U.S., we see that we have the opportunity to persuade those people to rent from EuroDollar in the UK," he added.
